scope: Independent narrow source/invocation review of the six fixed document-publication receipt collector; actual publisher execution and receipt acceptance remain separate.
checks: The four driver/supervisor result paths exactly equal both accepted concrete requests. The accepted documents branch copies the native index-after.raw after document adoption and post-state checks, then saves original-git-baseline.json after full original-object identity verification and final remote/index/configuration checks.

Reversing only the four fixed declaration/label groups reconstructs the full accepted 5,474-byte source 1598cd0f exactly. No filesystem, resource, gzip, output or argument-validation function changed.

All reads remain limited to six named files and their fixed parent metadata. Existing files must be ordinary, unchanged across held-handle read and final snapshot checks; missing files are represented explicitly. There is no directory enumeration, child process, write, native command, application private-store read or product execution.

The reader transports raw bytes, including the native index copy and PowerShell JSON with 64-bit creation ticks. It never parses or rewrites a result JSON. Each raw file has its exact length/hash/base64; the stable package excludes changing time and memory observations.

The unchanged single BelowNormal Node64 envelope enforces 1 GiB free memory, 128 MiB own RSS, 15-second elapsed/hard deadlines and 100 ms resource sampling. Each file is bounded to 2 MiB and the aggregate to 4 MiB.

Asynchronous level 1 gzip, a 37,500-byte compressed chunk, per-chunk/package hashes and the 65,000-character output limit remain unchanged. Only exact offset plus package hash may continue a prior package; every positive offset requires the expected 64-character digest and changed package bytes refuse.

The decoded gzip source in the exact 3,284-character invocation equals the frozen candidate bytes. Its first read passes 0 and dash, cwd F:/Dev, 15,000 ms outer bound and only the four supported connector argument fields.
Read the root binding preparation record and independently verified its stated inverse, source identity, command length and source roundtrip.

acceptance_boundary.missing_or_failed_receipts: Retain exact observations and reconcile; collector complete means transport complete, not publisher accepted.
acceptance_boundary.continuation: Use returned next_offset_bytes and package_sha256 with the same exact source; preserve all chunks before decoding and rehashing the full raw package.
